nodes.description: ZethrInterface instance pinned to a fixed external contract address used for token purchases and balance queries
Address receiving collected divs/ETH from the proxy contract
Privileged address initialized to msg.sender at deployment
Payable entrypoint that buys tokens on Zethr at the 33% rate and emits onTokenPurchase
Payable fallback function that accepts plain ETH transfers
Owner-only function that reassigns the bankroll address
Owner-only function that transfers the contract balance to bankroll
msg.sender used inside buyTokensWithProperEvent as caller, token recipient and balanceOf account
msg.sender used inside changeBankroll in the owner authorization require
msg.sender used inside sendDivsToBankroll in the owner authorization require
msg.sender used at construction time to set the owner state variable
External payable call zethr.buyAndTransfer.value(msg.value)(_referredBy, msg.sender, "", divChoice) forwarding arbitrary referredBy and divChoice
External call bankroll.transfer(address(this).balance) sending the whole contract balance to a mutable address
Arithmetic subtraction balanceAfter - balanceBefore used for the emitted tokensMinted amount
Parameter _referredBy of buyTokensWithProperEvent, an attacker-controlled referral address forwarded to the external call
Parameter divChoice (uint8) of buyTokensWithProperEvent selecting the dividend rate option
Parameter _newBankroll of changeBankroll, the new destination for contract funds
Local variable storing zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) before the purchase
Local variable storing zethr.balanceOf(msg.sender) after the purchase

edges.reason: msg.sender is read inside buyTokensWithProperEvent for balance queries and as token recipient
msg.sender is passed as the target argument to the external zethr.buyAndTransfer call
changeBankroll authorization depends on the untrusted msg.sender being equal to owner
sendDivsToBankroll authorization depends on the untrusted msg.sender being equal to owner
owner state variable is initialized directly from the deployment-time msg.sender
_referredBy is forwarded verbatim into the external buyAndTransfer call
divChoice is forwarded verbatim into the external buyAndTransfer call
_referredBy is consumed and emitted by buyTokensWithProperEvent
divChoice is consumed by buyTokensWithProperEvent
_newBankroll is the input parameter of changeBankroll
_newBankroll is written into the bankroll state variable after an owner check
changeBankroll mutates the bankroll state variable guarded by the owner require
changeBankroll reads owner to gate the bankroll reassignment
sendDivsToBankroll reads owner to gate the fund transfer
balanceBefore feeds the balanceAfter - balanceBefore subtraction
balanceAfter feeds the balanceAfter - balanceBefore subtraction which can underflow if balances shrink
balanceAfter is measured after the external buyAndTransfer call executes
The subtraction result is emitted as tokensMinted by buyTokensWithProperEvent
buyTokensWithProperEvent executes the external zethr.buyAndTransfer call
The external payable call transfers control to an untrusted contract that may reenter buyTokensWithProperEvent before balanceAfter is read
sendDivsToBankroll executes the bankroll.transfer call
The mutable bankroll address is the receiver of the full contract balance during transfer
The external transfer to bankroll hands control to a mutable address that could attempt to reenter sendDivsToBankroll

normalization_plan.reason: The _referredBy parameter has no independent semantics; it is only forwarded into the external buyAndTransfer unsafe operation
The divChoice parameter has no independent semantics; it is only forwarded into the external buyAndTransfer unsafe operation
The _newBankroll parameter is only consumed by the changeBankroll core function that assigns it to bankroll
The balanceBefore local only exists to be subtracted inside the arithmetic unsafe operation
The balanceAfter local only exists to be subtracted inside the arithmetic unsafe operation
